title: 第17章 贾府秘闻第18章 丛林追踪
slug: 梦中强吻女帝被找上门了怎么办
content_zh:
书房里门窗紧闭，光线阴暗，只有烛台的细火在摇曳。
甘小姐一身家居锦袍，妆容精致，肌肤白皙如美瓷，慵懒地倚在书桌前，眯着眼审视江晨。
在这样的氛围中，两人隔着书桌相望，看着对方脸庞的阴影随着烛火变幻不定，有一种微妙而诡异的感觉。
良久的沉默，江晨愈发笃定，这位甘小姐与贾夫人虽是亲姐妹，但恐怕仅是外表形似，实则气质大相径庭。
那位格调高雅、喜欢举办宴会的贾夫人，大概永远不会在阳光明媚的上午关闭门窗，躲在阴暗的书房里，以这样幽深的眼神观察来访的客人。
“已经过去一个月了。”甘小姐轻轻叹出一口气，“在西辽城失踪超过一个月的人，从来没有找回来的先例。虽然很难接受，可这就是事实。”
“贾四爷好像不愿接受这个事实。”
“我知道，他心里放不下姐姐。”甘小姐玉嫩光泽的脸上写满了惆怅，“可能需要更多的时间，他才会渐渐相信，姐姐终究是回不来了。姐夫是个痴心人，情深不寿，这种绝望会让他很痛苦，但比绝望更加令人痛苦的，是虚假的希望……”
江晨已经猜出了她的来意，不动声色地道：“这一回有赤阳大侠出马，未必就不可能——”
“谁来都没用！”甘小姐摇摇头，双手按在书桌上，嗓音中多了几分激动，“赤阳大侠带来的希望，只会让姐夫更加痛苦！我实在不忍心再看他遭受这种折磨了！”
“你就一点也不想知道你姐姐遭遇了什么吗？”
“想！可又有什么用？人死不能复生，生者还需要继续生活，不能被悲伤拖垮。”
“甘小姐的意思是？”
“放过他，也放过我们吧！”甘小姐激动之下，语声略带哽咽，“别再给他虚假的希望，让他渡过这道难关，开始新的生活！”
“可是我们——”
“不会让你们白来一趟。”甘小姐盯过来的眼神，又恢复了锐利与幽深，“只要你答应放过他，我会给你们一千两银子作为答谢。”
“这……”
“姐姐一定是死了，就算你们找到了那枚红宝石戒指，最多也只能拿到这些。”甘小姐观察着江晨脸上的神色变化，顿了顿，又道，“不过，出于对赤阳大侠的尊重，我愿意额外再出一千两，作为赤阳大侠放弃任务的补偿。”
“唔……”江晨沉吟，“我得和赤阳再商量商量。”
走出书房的时候，江晨就已经把甘小姐的建议抛到了脑后。

无需跟赤阳商量，江晨也知道，假如找不到贾夫人，拿不到那五千两银子，自己的下场只会比贾四爷更加痛苦。
走在花径上，江晨忽然停下脚步，指着路旁的一个粉衣丫鬟问道：“她叫什么名字？”
他注意到这个粉衣丫鬟背对着大路，似乎在悄悄抹眼泪，不禁生出了几分好奇。
带路的仆人脸色一变，凑到江晨耳边，小声说道：“少侠小心，这丫头身上染了邪祟，千万不要离她太近，不然也会倒霉的。”
“邪祟？”江晨笑了笑，“刚巧，我身上也有邪祟，说不定还是相识的熟人，正好跟她打声招呼。”
说着，他不理会仆人的劝阻，径自走到粉衣丫鬟身后，轻轻咳嗽一声：“姑娘，为何一个人在这里伤心？”
粉衣丫鬟吃了一惊，连忙用衣袖擦了擦眼睛，转过身来，朝江晨道了个万福，含着鼻音道：“请公子见谅，奴婢想心事想得入神，失礼了。”
江晨见她虽然眼眶泛红，是刚刚哭过的模样，但眼神清澈明亮，举止也颇为有礼，不像是中邪的样子，便问：“他们为什么说你中邪了？”
粉衣丫鬟面露悲戚之色：“是因为秋露……秋露死后，府里经常发生怪事，他们就说是秋露的冤魂在作怪。奴婢平时跟秋露走得近，替她说了几句好话，也被当成是中邪了。”
content_en:
The doors and windows in the study were closed, and the light was dim. Only the thin flame of the candlestick was flickering.
Miss Gan was dressed in a homely brocade robe, with exquisite makeup and skin as fair as porcelain. She leaned lazily on the desk and squinted her eyes to examine Jiang Chen.
In such an atmosphere, the two of them looked at each other across the desk, watching the shadows on each other's faces changing with the candlelight, giving them a subtle and strange feeling.
After a long silence, Jiang Chen became more and more certain that although Miss Gan and Mrs. Jia were biological sisters, they were probably only similar in appearance, but in fact they had very different temperaments.
Mrs. Jia, who has an elegant style and likes to hold banquets, would probably never close the doors and windows on a sunny morning, hide in the dark study, and observe the visiting guests with such deep eyes.
"It has been a month." Miss Gan sighed softly, "There has never been a precedent for people who have been missing in Xiliao City for more than a month to be found. Although it is difficult to accept, this is the fact."
"Fourth Master Jia seems unwilling to accept this fact."
"I know that he can't let go of his sister in his heart." Miss Gan's glossy face was full of melancholy. "It may take more time for him to gradually believe that my sister will never come back after all. My brother-in-law is an infatuated person, and his love will last forever. This kind of despair will make him very painful, but what is more painful than despair is false hope..."
Jiang Chen had already guessed her purpose of coming and said calmly: "With Hero Chiyang taking action this time, it may not be impossible -"
"It's useless for anyone to come!" Miss Gan shook her head and pressed her hands on the desk, with a little more excitement in her voice. "The hope brought by the Chiyang Hero will only make my brother-in-law more painful! I really can't bear to see him suffer this kind of torture anymore!"
"Don't you want to know at all what happened to your sister?"
"Think! But what's the use? People can't be resurrected after death. The living need to continue living and not be dragged down by sorrow."
"What does Miss Gan mean?"
"Let him go, let us go too!" Miss Gan was so excited that her voice was slightly choked, "Don't give him any more false hope, let him get over this difficulty and start a new life!"
"But we-"
"I won't let your trip go in vain." Miss Gan's gaze regained its sharpness and depth, "As long as you promise to let him go, I will give you one thousand taels of silver as a thank you."
"This..."
"Sister must be dead. Even if you find the ruby ring, you can only get this at most." Miss Gan observed the change in the expression on Jiang Chen's face, paused, and then said, "However, out of respect for the hero Chi Yang, I am willing to pay an additional thousand taels as compensation for the hero Chi Yang giving up the mission."
"Well..." Jiang Chen pondered, "I have to discuss this with Chiyang."
When Jiang Chen walked out of the study room, he had already forgotten Miss Gan's suggestion.
There was no need to discuss with Chi Yang, Jiang Chen also knew that if he couldn't find Mrs. Jia and couldn't get the five thousand taels of silver, his end would be even more painful than Fourth Master Jia's.
Walking on the flower path, Jiang Chen suddenly stopped, pointed at a maid in pink clothes on the side of the road and asked, "What's her name?"
He noticed that the maid in pink clothes had her back to the road and seemed to be quietly wiping away tears, and he couldn't help but feel a little curious.
The face of the servant leading the way changed, and he leaned into Jiang Chen's ear and whispered: "Young hero, be careful, this girl is infected with evil spirits. Don't get too close to her, otherwise you will be in trouble."
"Evil spirit?" Jiang Chen smiled, "It just so happens that I also have evil spirit in me. Maybe I am an acquaintance who happened to say hello to her."
With that said, he ignored the servant's dissuasion and walked directly behind the pink-clothed maid, coughing lightly: "Girl, why are you sad here alone?"
The maid in pink clothes was startled, and quickly wiped her eyes with her sleeves, turned around, wished Jiang Chen a blessing, and said in a nasal voice: "Please forgive me, sir.I'm so engrossed in my thoughts that I'm rude. "
Jiang Chen saw that although her eyes were red and she looked like she had just cried, her eyes were clear and bright, and her behavior was quite polite, and she did not look like she was possessed, so he asked, "Why do they say you are possessed? "
The maid in pink looked sad: "It's because of Qiu Lu... After Qiu Lu's death, strange things often happened in the house, and they said it was Qiu Lu's ghost that was causing trouble. The slave girl usually gets close to Qiu Lu and says a few nice words for her, but she is also considered to be possessed by evil spirits. "
